house_style.finish: bright white and polished silver, subtle shading and clean edges
accents: navy blue contained within light fuselage or tail surfaces
house_style.perspective: flying aircraft, visible wings where feasible, facing toward upper-right
house_style.branding: fictional red/white/navy striping, no real airline names, logos or registration
house_style.background: true transparent alpha; airplane and cloud assets separate
house_style.restrictions: No dashboard, text or atmospheric background is baked into aircraft art

integration: Static pre-rendered images only; application code/deployments unchanged; prefer WebP for runtime and retain PNG as source.
source_notes: Prior handover established accepted A380 1774x887 RGBA, retained pixel-identical and with matching checksum to current-conversation source. New narrow-body and cloud strip separated from generated source art. The 747 is explicitly excluded.
